correctness.rationale: The proof was reconstructed from Chen's axioms. Consequent monotonicity and a->b=a->(a meet b) make each row constant above a. Lower-bound plus self-importation makes every row value a fixed point, so q_a is the least-fixed-point ceiling map on b<=a. Cross-row importation for b<a is exactly S_b subset S_a together with the two summit cases. Conversely those conditions make importation hold on every row image. Under T, all summits equal top and semicomplementation forces 0 in S_a for a>0; the nested family is determined by independent first-entry stages t_j in {j+1,...,n-1}, giving product_{j=1}^{n-2}(n-1-j)=(n-2)!. The induced negation is top at 0 and 0 elsewhere, so F's double-negation inflation is automatic. The bundled verifier literally checks the source axioms for small n and normal-form counts through n=8; finite replay corroborates but does not establish the all-n theorem.
